_note: D7's set pieces (lane S session 10): the Merchants of the Elements' sky-barges (4051-4054) and Lucio's celestial boat (4055). Sprites 27051-27055, bindings in worlds/xeen/models/indoor_decorations.yml.

rows.name: xeen_skybarge_fire
comment: D7's Merchant of the Elements' gilded sky-barge, fire tint (red-orange sail, canopy, pennant and glow; the smoke
merchant's; lane S, level_generation/decorations/xeen_skybarge_claude): a lofted plank hull with a carved gilt
frieze and fluted gilt rail, gilt scroll posts at prow and stern, a mast with a bellied sail and glowing sigil,
a damask canopy over the port gangway, a gangplank and three crates. 1024 long, 384 wide (gangplank to 352
out of port), 721 tall (keel -196, mast orb +525). Origin = the deck's centre at deck height: floor_height =
the island floor. Facing = the way the prow points; the gangway is on the port side (facing + 90 deg), so
the island goes on the left. Radius 0 (no collision): the merchant stands on the island at the gangplank.

rows.name: xeen_skyboat
comment: D7's celestial boat at Lucio's dock (the boat that brought the party up; lane S,
level_generation/decorations/xeen_skybarge_claude): the sky-barges' family, smaller: plank hull, carved gilt
frieze and rail, gilt scroll posts, a mast with a pale-blue sail and glowing sigil, two thwarts. 736 long,
266 wide, 569 tall (keel -144, mast orb +425). Origin = the deck's centre at deck height (48 under the
jetty's top). Facing = the way the prow points. Radius 0 (no collision; nobody boards it).
